title: Children in Need: a big night to help children
lead: On 13 November 2026, a TV show in the UK raised more than £38 million for children and young people.
body: On Friday 13 November 2026, BBC Children in Need had its big TV show. It was live from Salford, in the north-west of England. Children in Need is a charity. It gives money to projects for children and young people in the UK.
There were songs, dances and funny surprises. People at home gave money by phone or online. At the end of the night, the total was £38,720,170!

Before the show, Owain Wyn Evans, a radio presenter, did a big challenge. He cycled nearly 400 miles in 5 days, from Glasgow in Scotland to Cardiff in Wales. He went through the 4 nations of the UK: Scotland, Northern Ireland, England and Wales.
The star of the charity is Pudsey, a yellow bear with a spotty bandana on his eye. Every year, a lot of schools have a Pudsey day: pupils wear yellow or spots and give some money.

questions.q: How far did Owain Wyn Evans cycle?

turn: Imagine a Pudsey day at your school. What can you do to help? On Pudsey day, I can wear… I can sell… I want to help…
